claims.claim_text_en: A national drought management plan was adopted in 2023 and requires herder communities to keep emergency fodder reserves.

brief.core_idea_en: Drought management in NDC 3.0 rests on the National Drought Management Plan adopted in 2023, which requires herder communities to maintain emergency fodder reserves. No drought monitoring or water-shortage measure beyond the plan's adoption appears in the pages read.

responses.text_en: National Drought Management Plan adopted in 2023, requiring herder communities to maintain emergency fodder reserves (NDC 3.0, p. 30).

gaps.text_en: Adoption of the plan is reported; no implementation, funding or drought-impact figures are given.
